title: Research 2026-10-23
body: Studied the engine's 939 orders (654 settled): +$25.18, ROI +8.6%; bid fills +5.4% (z 1.6). Player props +25% (n135), team totals +17% (n184), NFL +30% (n95) are paying. Leaks: spreads -12% (n110), game totals -16% (n67), WNBA -41% (n19): all under the 200-bet evidence gate, so no setting changed today. Next: re-test spreads and game totals at n 200, about 3 days. Engine healthy, trading live, trap guard is still the main hold-back.
